verdict.rationale: Docs describe a write-capable plugin API ("extensive access to objects and properties to enable... workflow automation", ability to "create and publish own custom extensions") and marketing language calling AI workflows "multi-directional", suggesting agents can modify not just read designs. However, the only concrete runtime evidence of the MCP server's actual tool surface (penpot-probe-rt-2) shows a single tool, "high_level_overview", which reads as read-only, and no OpenAPI/API spec was discoverable (404s in penpot-probe-1/2) to confirm a broader write API. Missing for 10: a documented list of MCP tools that explicitly create/modify shapes or files, an independent hands-on example of an agent editing a design via MCP or plugin API, and a working write endpoint in the public API docs.
